_registration: The bridge ships no install script or registry write; this manifest is the single reviewable source of truth. Steps: (1) replace the REPLACE_* placeholder for `path` with a real executable launcher for this bridge (a Node SEA single-executable build or a compiled shim - CreateProcess cannot launch a .js file directly), (2) create the HKCU value naming the ABSOLUTE path of this manifest file. The extension id is pinned by the extension manifest `key`.
_security: `allowed_origins` is the first check (NM-01: Chrome refuses a host whose allowed_origins does not match the extension id) and `expectedExtensionId` in src/config.js is the second (NM-02). They must agree: the bare id below, without scheme or slash. NOTE: Chrome passes the caller origin as a command-line argument (argv[1]), not as a framed message; the launcher or host must feed it into the NM-02 check.
